• At least one year of experience in customer service
• Familiarity with accounting terms

Date: June 21
Subject: Application — Customer Support Specialist

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Customer Support Specialist position advertised on your Web site. I am a native Portuguese speaker, and I have used English daily for the past four years in my current role at a hotel reservations center, where I handle guest inquiries by phone and e-mail. I also speak Spanish at an intermediate level.

Although I have not worked in the software industry, I completed an evening course in bookkeeping last year, so I am familiar with basic accounting vocabulary.

I am available for an interview at any time except June 27, when I will be traveling. I have attached my résumé.

Sincerely,
Beatriz Santos

answer: Experience in the software industry
explanation: 求人の要件にソフトウェア業界の経験は含まれていない。

Sunita Rao

Former Textile Mill to Become Mixed-Use Development

GRANTHAM FALLS (July 14) — The long-vacant Brayford textile mill on the east bank of the Carlow River will be converted into apartments, offices, and shops, the city planning board confirmed on Wednesday. The developer, Kestrel Urban Partners, intends to preserve the mill's brick facade and iconic clock tower while rebuilding the interior entirely.

The first phase, comprising 84 apartments, is due for completion in late 2027, with office space and ground-floor retail units following in the second phase. Under an agreement with the city, 20 percent of the apartments will be offered at below-market rents to households earning less than the regional median income.

Some residents had opposed the scheme, citing concerns about parking. In response, Kestrel has reduced the number of apartments from 110 to 84 and added an underground garage.

--- Text 2 ---

To: Leasing Inquiries, Kestrel Urban Partners
From: Nadia Petrenko
Date: September 3
Subject: Brayford Mill apartments

Hello,

I read about the Brayford Mill project in the local paper and am very interested in renting a two-bedroom apartment there. My partner and I both work in the city center and would prefer a unit facing the river.

Could you tell me when applications will open and whether parking spaces are included in the rent? Also, my household income is somewhat below the regional median, so I would like to know how to apply for one of the reduced-rent units.

Thank you,
Nadia Petrenko

--- Text 3 ---

Brayford Mill — Phase 1 Apartment Types (preliminary)

Type | Bedrooms | Size | Est. monthly rent | View | Units
A | 1 | 52 m² | $1,250 | Courtyard | 30
B | 1 | 58 m² | $1,380 | River | 18
C | 2 | 76 m² | $1,690 | Courtyard | 22
D | 2 | 84 m² | $1,850 | River | 14

Parking: $95 per month per space (limited availability)
Applications open November 1. Reduced-rent units are allocated by lottery.
question: According to the article, why was the number of apartments reduced?
choices: To address local concerns about parking
Because the city requested more offices
To make room for the clock tower
answer: To address local concerns about parking
explanation: 駐車場への懸念を受けて戸数を110から84に減らし地下駐車場を加えた。

Northline Rail — Service Changes, October 18–19

Due to signal upgrades between Ashford Junction and Kelby, the following changes will apply this weekend:

• Trains between Ashford Junction and Kelby will be replaced by buses. Allow up to 40 extra minutes for your journey.
• Bicycles cannot be carried on replacement buses, except folding bicycles.
• Express services from Kelby to Port Hale will run as normal.
• Tickets valid for the affected dates may be used on the buses at no extra cost. Customers who choose not to travel may claim a full refund at any ticket office until October 31.

Normal service will resume on Monday, October 20.

--- Text 2 ---

To: Customer Relations, Northline Rail
From: Graham Whitlock
Date: October 21
Subject: Weekend journey

Dear Customer Relations,

On Saturday, I traveled from Ashford Junction to Port Hale. I had heard there would be delays, so I left home early. However, when I arrived at the bus stop with my bicycle, the driver would not let me board, even though I explained that I had reserved a space for it on the train. I had to wait for a taxi, which cost me $48, and I missed my connection at Kelby.

Nobody at the station mentioned this rule when I bought my ticket on Friday. I would like to be reimbursed for the taxi fare.

Sincerely,
Graham Whitlock
question: Why were train services changed?
choices: To make room for a special event
To allow work on signaling equipment
answer: To allow work on signaling equipment
explanation: 信号設備の改良工事のためと書かれている。
